snippet.title: Night Pump — Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Night Pump — Official Demo Trailer
A night shift at an isolated gas station. Strange customers. Strange noises.
You are Jake, 19 years old. Your manager just left. You are alone until 6 AM.
Night Pump is a short first-person horror game set at Route 9 Gas, an isolated station surrounded by nothing but forest and darkness. Serve customers, try to stay calm, and when the lights go out — don't make a sound.
🎮 Play the demo for free: https://zolvek.itch.io/night-pump

#horror  #indiegame  #indiehorror  #godot  #fearstofathom #Nightpump
